A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locat

texts.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
texts.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locating its source will prove difficult. It may already be too late to help.

label.zh: 如果还有机会就试试看。
label.en: If there's a chance, we have to take it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：触发地点是银河生成时标记了 legendary_leader_spawn_system 的星系；任一舰队首次进入且尚无人找到冷冻舱（全局旗标 frozen_legendary_leader_found）时触发。
notes.en: Commentary: the location is the system flagged legendary_leader_spawn_system at galaxy generation; the first fleet to enter it while nobody has found the capsule (global flag frozen_legendary_leader_found) triggers it.

texts.zh: 需要花费许多时间去定出[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星上的求救信号准确的地表位置。
texts.en: It will take time to pinpoint the exact planetary position of the distress signal on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上找到了求救信号的来源。

地壳深处埋藏着一个古老的逃生舱。它的冷冻胶囊仓里似乎有一个外星人幼体。

尽管这个逃生舱已经非常老了，但低温保存设备仍然在运行中，幼体的生命迹象也很稳定。在胶囊的外部粗略地刻着一系列符号。我们将其翻译成：“我们的希望。我们的未来。我们的子孙。”
texts.en:
We have found the source of the distress signal on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

Buried deep within the planet's crust was an ancient escape pod. Its cryostasis capsule contained what appears to be an alien child.

Despite the pod's extreme age, the cryopreservation equipment was still functioning, and the child's life signs are stable. On the capsule's exterior a series of symbols were roughly carved. We translated the symbols: 'Our hope. Our future. Our Scion.'

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子在经历了比任何已知历史更久的冷冻期之后成功地活了下来。复苏工作需要小心谨慎的准备。
texts.en: The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has survived a longer period of cryostasis than any in recorded history. Resuscitation will require careful and meticulous preparation.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]上发现的孩子成功复苏了。所有的生命迹象都符合该类生命形式的合理范畴。目前他还没有恢复意识，也许还要一段时间才能苏醒。

在逃生舱内还发现了一些物品。第一件是一块略微损坏的数据水晶，记录了孩子的姓名、年龄和物种。他叫做艾克萨凯德斯”，完整的日志表明他还是瓦格罗的子嗣。第二件是一个由未知重金属构成的古怪文物。从该文物的设计上看，好像应该属于一个更大装置的一部分。进一步研究已正在计划中。

现在更紧迫的任务是要如何对待这个孩子。不管艾克萨凯德斯到底是，或者曾是什么人，目前来讲他需要照料。
texts.en:
The child discovered on [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName] has been successfully resuscitated. All vital signs are within a reasonable range for a lifeform of its type. Still unconscious, it may be some time before the child wakes.

A number of items were also discovered inside the pod. The first was a degraded data crystal which revealed the child's gender, name, and species. He is called Exakeides, and referred to throughout the log as the 'Scion of Vagros'. The second was a strange relic composed of an unknown, heavy material. Given its design, it is likely that this relic formed a part of a larger whole. Further study is advised.

Of more pressing concern is what to do with the child. Whoever this Exakeides is or was, for the time being he will require care.

label.zh: 我们会给艾克萨凯德斯一个家。
label.en: We will give Exakeides a home.

label.zh: 我们没有义务照顾这个孩子。
label.en: The child is not our responsibility.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在艾克萨凯德斯的冷冻舱里发现的破碎部件，该遗物远超我们目前的科学理解。需要很长的时间和资源来发现其中的秘密。
texts.en: A broken fragment discovered in Exakeides's cryostasis capsule, this relic is well beyond our current scientific understanding. It will take a significant investment of time and resources to uncover its secrets.

texts.zh: 目前进行中的对艾克萨凯德斯身边的破损遗物的研究表明，它曾与障碍物发生过碰撞。由于丢失的部件过多，我们只能对其真实功能进行猜测。然而，根据近距离观测时记录的异常读数，我们有理由得出结论，该物体对时空有影响。
texts.en: Our ongoing research into the broken relic discovered with Exakeides has hit a roadblock. Given how many pieces are missing, we can only speculate on its true purpose. However, based on the anomalous readings we've recorded while in close proximity, there is some reason to conclude that the object has an impact on spacetime.

texts.zh:
艾克萨凯德斯一直是一个非常早熟的孩子，随着十岁生日到来，他已经开始了更高级的学习。到目前为止，我们的重点一直是鼓励他无限的好奇心，并为他提供一切必要的工具来追求他的兴趣。在未来的几年里，他将由我们所能提供的最优秀的人才来指导。

他有潜力成为科学领域的领军人物，这足以证明我们的付出是会有回报的。问题是，要将他的教育将建立在什么基础上呢？
texts.en:
Always a remarkably precocious child, Exakeides's tenth year marks the beginning of more advanced studies. Until now, our focus has been on encouraging his boundless curiosity and providing him with all the tools necessary to pursue his interests. In the coming years, he will be tutored by the best minds we have to offer.

His potential to become a leader in the sciences more than justifies the investment. The question is, upon what foundation will his education proceed?

label.en: Push him to embrace the unknown.

label.zh: 警告他不要相信陌生人。
label.en: Warn him not to trust in outsiders.

label.zh: 让他学会敬畏生命的价值。
label.en: Impress upon him the value of life.
Remind him that strength is power.

label.zh: 让他在物质世界脚踏实地。
label.en: Ground him in the physical world.

notes.zh: 评注：养育选项按帝国伦理出现，选择会设下全局旗标 leader_raised_*，影响之后凯德斯的特质（events/paragon_events_3.txt:1906-1961）。
notes.en: Commentary: the upbringing options appear by empire ethic and set global flags leader_raised_* that shape Keides' traits later (events/paragon_events_3.txt:1906-1961).

texts.zh:
在二十岁时，艾克萨凯德斯已经准备好承担其一位成年人的责任了。

从被复苏那一刻起，他就像一块海绵一样狂热而执着地吸收着我们的教导。尽管他已经具有海量的技艺和无边的智慧，但仍旧谦虚如初。

科学一直是他最热衷的领域，促动着它去发现自己的过往，以及那台与他一同被发现的破碎遗物。在他的同僚中，他的名字被简化为了“凯德斯”。
texts.en:
On turning twenty years old, Exakeides is ready to assume the responsibilities of adulthood.

In the time since his resuscitation, he has absorbed our teachings with fervor and determination. Despite his prodigious skill and a boundless intellect, he remains humble.

Science has long been his passion, fueling his drive to uncover the truth of his past as well as the purpose of the broken relic he was found with. To his peers, he is known simply as 'Keides'.

label.zh: 是时候为他的下一步做规划了。
label.en: It is time to plan his next steps.

texts.zh:
你好。

凯德斯昂首站着，观察着形势，也在思考着自己对形势该作何反应。他的目光落在自己的双手上：那双手丝毫没有紧张的迹象，如磐石般沉稳。很明显他为这一天做了充分准备。

我准备好了。
texts.en:
Hello.

Standing tall, Keides observes the situation and his own response to it. His gaze falls to his hands: they are remarkably steady. He has prepared for this day.

I am ready.

responses.zh:
年轻人点了点头，并深吸了一口气。

我一直梦想着这么一天。从我记事的那一天起，我就一直期待着这一天。

我已经准备好，献上自己的一份力了。
responses.en:
The young man nods and takes a breath.

I have dreamed of this day. I have anticipated it for as long as I can remember.

I stand ready and willing to serve.

label.zh: 你会有够长的时间做出贡献的。但首先，你在追寻什么呢？
label.en: There will be enough time for that. But first, what do you seek?

responses.zh:
其他人又在追寻着什么呢？不过是了解自己，了解自己在宇宙中的位置罢了。

我觉得关键在于那个遗物。有了你们的帮助，我就能全身心地投入对其余部分的修复。但请不要误会我：这并不是一个出于自私或者虚荣的请求。我确信，这个物件的力量一定能造福我们的人民。

他顿了顿。

你们救了我的命，我对你们有所亏欠。但我需要寻找答案，因此需要你们的帮助。
responses.en:
What does anyone seek? To know themselves, to understand their place in the universe.

I believe the key lies with the relic. With your aid, I will commit myself to recovering the remaining pieces. But do not mistake me - this is no vain quest for selfhood. I am convinced that the power of this object will prove a great boon to our people.

He pauses.

I am indebted to you for saving my life. I need to find answers, and I need your help.

label.zh: 那么你找到了答案以后呢？那之后又如何？
label.en: And when you find what you seek? What then?

responses.zh:
凯德斯自豪地抬起了头。

这是一个非常有分量的问题，我也有很多答案。简而言之中，你们给了我一个家。无论这趟旅程会给我带来什么，不论我会学到什么，我都会与你们分享。这方面我说到做到。
responses.en:
Keides looks up proudly.

A weighted question, with many answers. In short, you have given me a home. Wherever this journey takes me, whatever I learn, I will share it with you. On that you have my word.

texts.zh:
对遗物进行初步调查时，凯德斯汇报了一段不同寻常的经历。

在进行物理接触后，他的脑海中出现了“幻视”；出现了人和地方的画面，是被埋在遥远过往的回忆。尽管他尚未完全理解其中的含义，但其中的一些画面描绘的是现实的地点。

凯德斯请求发起一个特殊项目对其进行探索。
texts.en:
Upon initial investigation of the relic, Keides has reported an unusual experience.

After physical contact, 'visions' have appeared in his mind; images of people and places, memories of a long forgotten past. Although he has yet to discern their full meaning, some of these visions depict real locations.

Keides is calling for a Special Project to explore them.

texts.zh:
凯德斯发来的一份正式请求，希望验证他的幻视是否是真实有意义的。

如果同意就有可能解锁他的过去和与他一同找到的神秘遗物的秘密。
texts.en:
A formal request from Keides to prove or disprove the validity of his visions.

Doing so may well unlock the key to his past and the mysterious relic he was found with.

label.en: Enter the first location system (volcanic planet) with Keides aboard; any order

label.zh: 带着凯德斯进入第二个地点系统（舰船坟场），先后顺序不限
label.en: Enter the second location system (ship graveyard) with Keides aboard; any order

texts.zh: 进入[From.GetName]星系之后不久，我们很快就定位了一颗符合凯德斯幻视的行星。在这颗行星的表面流淌着熔矿的海洋。
texts.en: Shortly after entry into the [From.GetName] system, a planet matching Keides's vision has been located. Oceans of molten minerals stream across the planet's surface.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
对瓦珀博恒星系中的这颗行星的初步调查证实了凯德斯的幻视中闪现的场景。

尽管地质不稳定，但此地仍有一些相互隔绝的坚实地面。探险还是有可能进行的。

该特殊项目必须由凯德斯本人施行。
texts.en:
Initial investigation of the planet in the Vapob system corroborates with the scenes glimpsed in Keides's vision.

Though geologically unstable, there are isolated areas of firm ground. An expedition is possible.

This Special Project must be researched by Keides himself.

texts.zh:
在惊涛拍岸的熔岩海洋中，凯德斯发现了一处矿物处理设施的遗迹。他报告有新的幻视：一条黑暗的走廊，通向一个密封的房间。根据这些影像，凯德斯找到了一个古老的、腐朽的盒子。盒子里面有一块残片，完全没有受到时间的摧残。

凯德斯汇报称，在接触到它的一瞬间，新的令人困惑的幻视立刻向他扑面而来。
texts.en:
Between the bays and swells of the planet's molten oceans, Keides discovered the remains of a mineral processing facility. He reported new visions of a dark corridor that led to a sealed room. Following these images led Keides to an ancient and moldering box. Inside the box, he found a fragment of the relic, untouched by the ravages of time.

Keides reports that upon touching it he was struck by a new and troubling vision.

texts.zh:
在凯德斯的身边浮现出了一座巨大熔炉的轧制流程。矿物、工厂、载具覆盖着大地，航母编队在空中遮天蔽日。在噪音之外，还有数量惊人的传送门，忽明忽灭，可以折叠起来。突然，天地间传来一声巨大的轰鸣，连大地都开始震颤。远处传来一阵绞痛的尖叫声。

从视野中恢复过来后，凯德斯将新的碎片与现有的碎片放在一起。一声尖锐的啸叫充满了空气。几乎就在同时，这两块碎片就自动融合在一起了。于是这件遗珍的影响变得更加强烈了。
texts.en:
The milling activity of a great furnace rose around Keides. Mines, factories, and vehicles blanketed the ground. Huge carrier vessels dotted the skies. Beyond the noise, there was a staggering number of portals, blinking in and out of existence, folding in on themselves. Suddenly there was a great rumbling, and the ground began to shake. A strangled scream came from the distance.

After recovering from his vision, Keides set the new fragment alongside the existing piece. A sharp whine filled the air. Almost instantly, the two parts fused together of their own accord. The relic's effects appear strengthened.

texts.zh:
在取回最后一块碎片后，遗物恢复如初，仿佛从未发生破碎一样。

随着遗物复原，对其目的进行研究迫在眉睫，且随时可以准备就绪。一项由凯德斯抓总的特殊项目已经准备就绪。
texts.en:
After the retrieval of the final fragment, the relic appears as if it was never broken.

Upon the relic's restoration, research on its purpose is promising and ready to continue. A Special Project led by Keides has been prepared.

texts.zh: 重重谜题围绕着凯德斯所复原的遗物，而这是一次解答这些谜题的尝试。这是他幻视的来源吗？如果是这样，那么这件遗物还具有什么能力呢？
texts.en: An endeavor to answer the questions surrounding Keides's restored relic. Was it indeed the cause of his visions? And if so, what further powers does it possess?

texts.zh:
对最近复原的遗物进行的研究带来了一些引人注目的发现。

它确实与凯德斯有所联系：当与其瓦格罗基因接触时，遗物中的粒子会开始高频共振。尽管这背后的机制尚不清楚，但这种效应是时空操纵所体现的特征。

在数次尝试测量并控制该过程后，凯德斯经历了又一次幻视。
texts.en:
Research into the recently restored relic has led to some intriguing discoveries.

Its connection to Keides has been affirmed. When in contact with his Vagrosian DNA, the relic's particles begin to resonate at high frequencies. Although the mechanics behind this remain unknown, the effects are symptomatic of space-time manipulation.

After several attempts to measure and control this process, Keides experienced another vision.

texts.zh:
凯德斯描述了一种仿佛从里面看到遗物的感觉。恒星大小的粒子在他周围旋转。在两者间的虚空中，他经感受到一股力量涌了上来。仅凭双手，他就能指挥球体的运动。

凯德斯从幻象中回来，把手放在了遗物上。现在他已经了解了它的用途，以及它惊人的能力：如果控制得当，它能使空间中的两点坍缩，创造一对稳定的虫洞。瓦格罗人称这种装置为楔。

在他的发现的激励下，凯德斯主动在我们的母星系中打开了一个虫洞。连他自己都不知道这条路通向哪里，但他仍然坚定，相信这很可能是他族人的家园。
texts.en:
Keides describes seeing the relic as if from within. Particles the size of suns swirled around him. In the void between, he experienced a surge of power. With his hands alone, he commanded the movements of the spheres.

Returning from this vision, Keides placed his hands on the relic. Now he understood its use, and the astonishing scope of its power. When properly controlled, it has the ability to collapse two points in space, effectively creating a stable wormhole. The Vagrosians called this device a Key.

Spurred by his discovery, Keides acted on his own initiative to open a wormhole in our home system. Not even he knows where it leads, but he remains resolute, believing it is likely his people's home.

label.zh: 让我们尽快找到答案吧。
label.en: Let us find out, sooner rather than later.

label.zh: 通过虫洞抵达终点系统（苏尔瑟克特）时
label.en: On arriving through the wormhole at the final system (Sursect)

texts.zh:
遗物所生成的虫洞的另一端是瑟塞特星系。进入后不久，我们的传感器发现了一队有敌意的无人机。它们似乎在守护着这个星系唯一的一颗行星。初步的扫描结果显示，那些无人机上没有生命形式的信号，行星上同样也没有。

凯德斯非常确信那颗行星就是他们民族的起源地。毫无疑问答案就在那里。

随后，无人机群向我们发出了通讯要求。
texts.en:
At the other end of the relic-spawned wormhole lies the Sursect system. Shortly after entry, our sensors picked up a fleet of hostile drones. They appear to be keeping vigil over the system's single planet. Initial scans suggest there are no life forms present among them, nor on the planet itself.

Keides has stated with certainty that the planet is indeed the origin of his people. It is sure to hold answers.

A demand from the drones to open comms follows.

notes.zh: 评注：故事的最后一站——终点星系里的星球是考古遗址“传奇领袖故乡”，由 site-paragon-legendary-leader-homeworld（C2）收录。
notes.en: Commentary: the last stop — the planet in the final system is the archaeological site "Legendary Leader homeworld", covered by site-paragon-legendary-leader-homeworld (C2).

texts.zh:
随着频道开启，尖锐的静电噪音与机器人模拟语音混合在一起。在一个周期内，每个声音都与下一个声音重叠，信息的音量在不规则的波中振荡。

动机：回收楔，违反章程。
瓦格罗之楔，状态：未收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：违反。

目标行为：归还楔。
应对方式：摧毁目标。
texts.en:
As the channel opens, screeching static blends with a wash of robotic vocalization. In cycles each voice overlaps the next, the message's volume oscillating in irregular waves.

IMPETUS: key confiscation, charter breach.
VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: uncollected.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: in breach.

TARGET ACTION: return key.
COUNTERACTION: destroy target.

label.zh: 遗物是我们的。另寻他法。
label.en: The relic is ours. Find another way.

label.zh: 将楔交给他们。我们的安全是首位的。
label.en: Give them the Key. Our safety is the priority.

label.zh: 或者以武力击毁无人机舰队
label.en: Or destroy the drone fleet by force

texts.zh:
凯德斯发起的一项特殊项目，旨在缓解瑟塞特恒星系中无人机的哨戒。

他打算用电磁场摧毁其电源。如果成功的话我们就能去到这个星系的的行星上了。
texts.en:
A Special Project prompted by Keides, to relieve the Sursect system's drones of their vigil.

He intends to deploy an electromagnetic field to knock out their power sources. A successful outcome should afford us access to the system's planet.

texts.zh:
我们发射了一股电磁脉冲，烧毁了这些无人机的电路。

我们现在可以自由探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
texts.en:
We delivered an electromagnetic pulse which fried the circuits of the drones.

We are now free to explore the Sursect system and its planet.

texts.zh:
合成语音的吱嘎声逐渐放慢，暂时停顿，然后继续说出最后几句话。

瓦格罗之楔，状态：紧急收集。
瓦格罗帝国章程第412条，状态：暂时忽略。

行为：待机。
texts.en:
The crackle of artificial voices is slowed, halting momentarily, then continues.

VAGROSIAN KEY, STATUS: collection imminent.
VAGROS-IMPERIAL CHARTER NO. 412, STATUS: tentatively omitted.

ACTION: hold.

texts.zh:
将楔交给那支舰队后，那些无人机立刻顺着一个它们自己的虫洞离开了。

在那之后，虫洞在它们身后关上了。我们现在可以自由地探索这个恒星系和里面的行星了。
texts.en:
Upon handing over the Key to the fleet, the drones promptly departed through a wormhole of their own.

Afterwards, the wormhole closed behind them. We are now free to explore the system and its planet.

label.zh: 我们做出了正确的选择。

texts.zh:
尽管无人机群被击败了，但是它们的制造者也留了一手，让摧毁它们的人也捞不到什么好处。无人机在回应我们的攻击时，启动了自毁程序。残余的东西难以被打捞。

不过，我们现在可以自由地探索瑟塞特恒星系和里面的行星了。
texts.en:
Despite the drones' defeat, whoever created them made sure that no one could benefit from their destruction. The drones initiated self-destruct protocols in response to our attack. What little remains is hardly salvageable.

Still, we are now free to explore the Sursect system and its planet.

label.zh: 这仍然算得上是一场胜利。
label.en: This still counts as a victory.

texts.zh: 如凯德斯的幻视一般，我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到了一座舰船之冢。
texts.en: Just as in Keides's vision, we have observed a graveyard of ships on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

texts.zh:
我们在伊弗施恒星系的一颗行星上观测到一座舰船的坟场，与凯德斯的幻视非常相似。

该特殊项目必须由凯德斯本人研究。
texts.en:
A graveyard of ships, eerily similar to the one in Keides's vision, has been observed on a planet in the Ivusheh system.

This Special Project must be researched by Keides himself.

texts.zh:
行星的碎裂表面四散着破旧的舰船。在最大的一处残骸堆中心，凯德斯发现了一座巨大恒星基地的主框架。

把他带到这颗行星一样的不可抗拒的力量又出现了，牵引着凯德斯走向基地内的一个房间。在被尘封的货仓中是遗物的另一个碎片。

在触碰到新发现的碎片的一瞬间，凯德斯被拉入了一个幻视当中。
texts.en:
The planet's broken surface is littered with battered spacecraft. At the center of the largest debris field, Keides discovered the framework of a colossal starbase.

With irresistible power, the pull of whatever led Keides to the planet drew him to a single room inside the base. Among the dust-covered cargo waited another piece of the relic.

Upon touching the newfound fragment, Keides was plunged into another vision.

label.en: What did he see this time?

texts.zh:
一座围绕着这颗行星的恒星基地。其船坞中源源不断地涌出战列舰的编队。

在旗舰的甲板上，站立着一位年轻的舰队司令，一手握着一件与遗物相仿的物体。随着他手腕的一挥，飞船外的空间模糊、变暗，然后逐渐折叠显现出一个黑洞。当这位舰队司令命令舰队进入黑暗时，幻象突然结束了。

凯德斯带着碎片回到船上，把它放在现有的碎片旁边。它们都开始发出刺耳的嗡嗡声振动起来。然后，在某种未知力量的作用下，两块融合成一体。事后，遗物的效果似乎加强了。
texts.en:
A vast starbase orbited the planet. From its docks flowed an unending procession of battleships.

On the deck of the flagship a young admiral stood, grasping in one hand an object resembling the relic. With a flick of his wrist, the space outside his ship blurred, darkened, then folded into itself as a black hole appeared. As the admiral ordered his fleet into the darkness, the vision abruptly ended.

Returning aboard with the fragment, Keides placed it next to the existing piece. Both began to vibrate with a piercing hum. Then, by some unknown force, the two pieces fused into one. After the fact, the relic's effects appear strengthened.

texts.zh: 追踪着凯德斯的幻视，我们来到了一颗位于[From.GetName]恒星系的行星。茂密的丛林覆盖了地面的90%。
texts.en: Following Keides's vision has led us to a planet in the [From.GetName] system. Dense jungle covers more than 90% of its land area.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
如果这颗位于塔普入恒星系的行星和凯德斯幻视中所见的一般，那么我们在这里应该小心再小心。

该特殊项目必须由凯德斯本人研究。
texts.en:
If the planet in the Taprib system is anything like the one Keides saw in his vision, we should exercise extreme caution.

This Special Project must be researched by Keides himself.

texts.zh:
野生丛林存在重重危险，要想安全地导航是十分困难的。凯德斯不止一次从鬼门关逃了出来。

尽管如此，在一种神秘力量的吸引下，他仍继续前进，终于发现了一座巨大建筑的杂草丛生的遗迹。一个摇摇欲坠的楼梯井通向一座远高于林冠的基座。在那里的黑色金属底座上，有另一块遗物碎片。

几乎就在一瞬间，凯德斯被拉入了幻视场景中。
texts.en:
The perils of the wild jungle have proven difficult to safely navigate. More than once, Keides has narrowly escaped the jaws of death.

Even so, drawn by a mysterious force, he pressed on, only to discover the overgrown remnants of a massive structure. A crumbling stairwell led to a pedestal far above the canopy. There, resting on a plinth of black metal, was another fragment of the relic.

Almost instantly, Keides was plunged into a vision.

texts.zh:
树木都散开了，取而代之的是一片苍翠的景色。这是一颗美丽而温顺的星球，有大型森林一般大小的动物围栏，包含了来自星系各处的物种。

突然，幻视把凯德斯扯入进了一座大型建筑内的一个房间。其中一面墙描绘着数个恒星系的星图。其中四个星系与其他的明显不同，没有超空间航道连接。

从幻视中回到船上，凯德斯把最新的一块遗物放在现有的部分旁边。它们发出嗡嗡声，肉眼可见地相互吸引，然后融合在一起。遗物的效果似乎加强了。
texts.en:
The vegetation peeled back, giving way to a green vista. A beautiful, tamed world, with animal enclosures the size of large forests, containing species from all over the galaxy.

Suddenly, the vision jolted Keides into a room inside a larger building. One wall depicted a map of several star systems. Four stood out clearly from the rest, unconnected by hyperlanes.

Back aboard the ship,Keides set the newest piece of the relic alongside the existing one. Humming, and visibly drawn towards one another, they fused. The relic appears strengthened.

summary.text:
# 艾克萨凯德斯 / Exakeides

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Galactic Paragons

## 如何开始 How it starts

银河生成时某个系统被标记为 legendary_leader_spawn_system；任一舰队首次进入该系统、且尚无人找到冷冻舱时，触发舰队事件 paragon.3100“求救信号”（on_entering_system_first_time）。

At galaxy generation one system is flagged legendary_leader_spawn_system; the first fleet to enter it while nobody has found the cryostasis capsule triggers the ship event paragon.3100 "Distress Signal" (on_entering_system_first_time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

3100：微弱信号，可定位或无视 → 专项“求救信号来源”→ 3104：古老逃生舱，里面是外星幼儿 → 专项“冷冻复苏”→ 3105：复苏成功，可收养、不管或吃掉 → 遗物碎片专项（3110）；收养后10年 3114 成长（按帝国伦理选择教导）、再10年 3115 长大成人 → 3116 招募或忽略凯德斯 → 60–120天后 3117 遗物幻视，开启事件链“遗物幻视”。之后带着凯德斯去三处地点（火山行星 3120、舰船坟场 3130、丛林行星 3125，次序不限），每处完成专项并看到幻视；三处完成后 3135 复原遗物 → 专项 → 3140 → 3141 在终点星系与本国附近各生成虫洞。进入终点系统 3144：自动无人机舰队，三种对策：电磁脉冲（3145→专项→3148）、交出钥匙（3146→3147，失去遗物）、武力击毁（3149）。终点星球的考古遗址见 C2 的故事。

3100: a faint signal — try to locate it or ignore it → project "Source of the Distress Signal" → 3104: an ancient escape pod with an alien child → project "Cryo Resuscitation" → 3105: the child lives; adopt, ignore or eat him → relic-fragment project (3110); if adopted, 3114 growth at 10 (upbringing by empire ethic) and 3115 adulthood 10 years later → 3116 recruit or ignore Keides → 3117 relic visions 60–120 days later, starting the event chain "Relic Visions". Then take Keides to three sites (volcanic planet 3120, ship graveyard 3130, jungle planet 3125, any order), each with a project and a vision; after all three, 3135 restores the relic → project → 3140 → 3141 spawns wormholes in the final system and near the empire. Entering the final system, 3144: an automated drone fleet with three answers: an electromagnetic pulse (3145 → project → 3148), hand over the Key (3146 → 3147, relic lost) or destroy them (3149). The planet's archaeological site is in the C2 story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三个互相替代的结局对付无人机（见上）；招募或忽略凯德斯（3116）；收养、不管或吃掉幼儿（3105，后两者没有后续的长大与招募）。

Three alternative answers to the drones (above); recruit or ignore Keides (3116); adopt, ignore or eat the child (3105 — the last two end the growth and recruitment line).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

3114 的教导选项依帝国伦理出现（亲外/排外/和平/军国/平等/威权/灵性/唯物）；3105 的“收养”不对嗜杀和集群开放，“吃掉”只对吞噬蜂群或“进化掠食者”起源（且不尊重他者）开放，所有选项都会给予遗物碎片 r_wormhole_key_fragment_1。

The upbringing options of 3114 depend on empire ethics (xenophile/xenophobe/pacifist/militarist/egalitarian/authoritarian/spiritualist/materialist); in 3105 "adopt" is closed to homicidal and gestalt empires, "eat" is open only to Devouring Swarm or Evolutionary Predators (not valuing others), and every option grants the relic fragment r_wormhole_key_fragment_1.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：`events/paragon_events_3.txt:1713-3000`; `common/event_chains/00_event_chains_paragon.txt:11`; `common/solar_system_initializers/paragon_initializers.txt:466,796`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:935,960-962,1670`; `common/special_projects/01_projects_paragon.txt`
- 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.
核对了 events/paragon_events_3.txt:1713-3000 全部事件、专项、事件链定义（common/event_chains/00_event_chains_paragon.txt:11）和 common/solar_system_initializers/paragon_initializers.txt:466,796。原先的6张卡（3100、3120、3125、3130、3144、3149）并为一条故事，三处幻视地点共用的 3135→3141 合为一条路径。

Checked all events, projects and the event-chain definition (common/event_chains/00_event_chains_paragon.txt:11) in events/paragon_events_3.txt:1713-3000 and the initializers (common/solar_system_initializers/paragon_initializers.txt:466,796). The former six cards (3100, 3120, 3125, 3130, 3144, 3149) are merged into one story; the shared 3135→3141 tail of the three vision sites is now a single path.
